integrity: Analytic proof and embedded exact-arithmetic symbolic verifier; finite algebra does not by itself prove the global statements. Research finding, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Sharp threshold concerns feasible spectral Hopf crossings within symmetric Monod subclass, not oscillations for all systems; full Hopf nondegeneracy is proved only for exact example. Global no-cycle proof covers d<=D; intermediate D<d<=2D remains unrestricted as to large-amplitude cycles. Prior general equilibrium stability theory is acknowledged.
title: A sharp common-removal Hopf barrier in an obligate-mutualist chemostat
